species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 64°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 14–38 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 55 ft, cold below.
Northwest wind at 9 mph pushes bait onto the southeast shore: try the wind-blown banks.
